A, so the t and A dependence is coupled, not separable.

Forms I tried that did not beat 0.027: a two-term additive law, an exp(t) numerator over a power-in-A·t denominator, an exp(−A·t) suppression, a t-dependent A-exponent, and a Langmuir denominator with exp(t). The last of these gave NMSE 0.39.
